summary: Attempted to test the new Select-all/Deselect bulk-delete feature on /admin/get-in-touch. BLOCKER: ADMIN_USERNAME and ADMIN_PASSWORD are MISSING from /app/backend/.env, so the admin UI cannot be reached by this agent. The .env currently contains only Backend_Email_Key, CORS_ORIGINS, DB_NAME, MONGO_URL, RESEND_API_KEY, SECURITY_* and SMTP_PASSWORD. Memory file /app/memory/test_credentials.md still says both keys should be in backend/.env mode-0600 after the 2026-09-23 rotation, so they appear to have been lost/not re-provisioned in this forked preview. The DB admin_settings record is intact (login endpoint returns 401 on admin/admin, i.e. real credentials still required). Static code review of ConsultationTable.jsx / useConsultationEnquiries.js / GetInTouchForms.jsx was completed and the implementation looks correct against the spec. Fixture pipeline was verified end-to-end via the public API: /api/form-context handshake + 2 consulting-4 POSTs with 'TEST bulk-delete' succeeded (ids 32ab7d54… and 62e215af…), then cleaned up via direct MongoDB delete_many on contact_enquiries (deleted_count=2) because UI bulk-delete could not be exercised without credentials.

integration_issues.issue: Could not execute end-to-end UI test because admin credentials are missing from backend/.env; login POST with admin/admin returns 401. All 10 planned Playwright assertions were skipped.

critical_code_review_comments: ConsultationTable.jsx: toggleAll + select-all semantics look correct (checked=allOn when every row on the page is selected; indeterminate=true when partial). Header checkbox aria-label switches between 'Select all enquiries on this page' and 'Deselect all enquiries on this page', matching the spec of 'current page only'.

useConsultationEnquiries.js setChecked([]) is called inside the useEffect that reloads data (triggered by page/limit/query change) and inside removeChecked's final refresh, so selection is correctly cleared on page/pageSize/search change and after a successful bulk delete.

removeChecked uses Promise.allSettled and surfaces partial failures via a readable error (`${failed} of ${checked.length} enquiries could not be deleted…`) which is good UX, though it still calls refresh() so successful deletions are reflected even on partial failure.

Minor UX: when busy=true the per-row and header checkboxes are disabled but the SelectionBar buttons are also disabled; however the entire row group is NOT dimmed so a user might wonder why nothing clicks for a split-second during a bulk-delete. Not a blocker.
Confirm prompt uses window.confirm (as requested in the spec).

rca of the issue: Credential blocker RCA: /app/backend/.env currently has 17 lines and none define ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD. The 2026-09-23 rotation note (memory/test_credentials.md L19) states the generated password was written only into this mode-0600 file and never into chat/source — if this forked preview inherited the DB but a sanitised .env, those keys are gone forever (bcrypt is one-way). Mitigation: either (a) owner provides the password out-of-band for test agents, or (b) a one-time authenticated password rotation via POST /api/admin/change-password from the owner's browser session to a new value that is then persisted in .env again. Testing agent must NOT attempt to overwrite the admin_settings doc in Mongo as that would wipe the owner's active credential.
